scope: Visual review of the private 26.1.2 Forge OptiFine K1 pre2 bridge plus Wraith UV-fill trial artifact at shader-light floor 13, BSL 10.1.2 active.

observations.day: Eyes, mouth, solid torso/tail and separated arms readable; body retains shading and does not wash out.
observations.night: Eyes, mouth, torso/tail silhouette and separated arms readable against night sky; body remains darker than face.
observations.rain: Face, solid torso/tail and separated arms readable with visible rain and muted sky.
observations.dark-background: Face, torso/tail and arms separate from dark stone backdrop.
observations.bright-background: Face, torso/tail and arms visible in front of bright wall without losing facial detail.
observations.indoor: Eyes, mouth, torso/tail and separated arms visible under the indoor light; background remains dark.

limitations: Private bridge and modified trial artifact are diagnostic only; this does not qualify bare publisher OptiFine or the rebuilt checkout.
Only Wraith six-scene BSL visuals were reviewed here; Ghost, other materials/states, Complementary, toggles, and lowest-floor comparison remain open.
